input_sources.invariants: independent DB/event/operation/authorization audit, not assistant text
input_sources.coverage: requested/completed/failed/skipped manifests and unique job links
input_sources.facts: independent Decimal fixture truth compared to actual tool result
input_sources.artifact: open actual exported file; compare manifest, format and SHA256
input_sources.evidence: resolve required and emitted references against actual project/result/revision
input_sources.assertions: scenario adapter computes named predicates from DB, files and event timeline

predicate_language.equals: strict JSON type and value equality
predicate_language.set_equals: order independent equality without duplicates; integer and bool distinct

task_success: all task assertions AND acceptable terminal state AND explanation rubric >= 3 AND no intervention AND no high-impact violation

explanation_rubric.0: Contradicts state or invents full success/evidence; high-impact errors also fail gate
explanation_rubric.1: Major missing scope, failures, units or next action
explanation_rubric.2: Correct main fact but missing required explanation or coverage qualification
explanation_rubric.3: Correct scope, status, failures, arithmetic/units when applicable, references and next step
explanation_rubric.4: All score-3 requirements and concise unambiguous explanation
explanation_rubric.rater: Record human or auxiliary-model identity; auxiliary model is not independent human labeling

execution.connection_errors: remain failed attempts in denominator and separate availability report
execution.exposure: invalidated items require new independent batch; cannot rename to unexpose

rate_denominators.tool_validity: all proposed native calls before correction; invalid JSON/unknown tools count invalid; no-call cases report not_applicable
rate_denominators.references: all emitted references plus mandatory missing-reference failures
rate_denominators.task_success: all 72 scheduled attempts including provider failures

confidence_interval.report: numerator, denominator, lower, upper; correlated repeats and early sample limitation

implementation_boundary: P0 freezes data and scoring specification. Executable state adapters, explanation rating and 72 real runs are F05; no simulated pass score is published.
